description: What scripts/eng/rehearse.mjs puts on main of the scratch project vitana/rehearsal. Every file of this folder except manifest.json is copied to the same path, except the folder spec/, which goes to .kiro/specs/rehearsal/. The collab tooling is copied from main of the platform checkout the script runs from, to tools/collab/ (never to scripts/collab/: those paths are protected gate files and the merge bot would refuse the seed). rehearsal.config.json is generated.
